$comment: Schema 1 of the catalogue. Every value in SI units, given in each number's "unit"; an empty CSV field is a value the source does not give.
title: pneumatic_cylinder
description: A double-acting pneumatic cylinder: one series, piston diameter and end-position cushioning.

part_number.description: The maker's part number, where a row is one part; empty for a series configured by stroke.

size.description: The size as the maker names it (the piston diameter in mm).

cushioning.description: The end-position cushioning as the maker names it (PPV: pneumatic, adjustable at both ends).

max_impact_energy_j.description: The kinetic energy of the moved mass the end positions take, as printed.

force_gauge_pressure_pa.description: The gauge pressure the theoretical forces are printed at.
